# Chaṭṭha Saṅgāyana Tipiṭaka Pāḷi (VRI)
> Complete Chaṭṭha Saṅgāyana Tipiṭaka (Sixth Buddhist Council) Pali Canon texts, commentary, sub-commentary, and dictionaries with 15 modern translations.

## Overview
- **Corpus**: Chaṭṭha Saṅgāyana Tipiṭaka (Vipassana Research Institute / CSCD edition).
- **Total Canonical Books**: 217 books.
- **Total Chapters**: 2,695 chapters across 520,000+ paragraphs.
- **Languages / Scripts**: Pāḷi in Roman (Latin with full IAST diacritics) + 16 Asian & historic scripts.
- **Translations Available**: 15 languages (English, Vietnamese, Burmese, Sinhala, Chinese, Thai, German, Japanese, Portuguese, Hindi, Khmer, Lao, Tamil, Russian, Myanmar Nissaya) with 14M+ sentence-aligned translations.
- **Canonical Piṭakas**:
  1. **Vinaya Piṭaka** (Monastic Rules): Pārājikapāḷi, Pācittiyapāḷi, Mahāvaggapāḷi, Cūḷavaggapāḷi, Parivārapāḷi, plus commentaries (Aṭṭhakathā) and sub-commentaries (Ṭīkā).
  2. **Sutta Piṭaka** (Discourses): Dīgha Nikāya, Majjhima Nikāya, Saṃyutta Nikāya, Aṅguttara Nikāya, Khuddaka Nikāya (Dhammapada, Sutta Nipāta, Jātaka, etc.), plus Aṭṭhakathā and Ṭīkā.
  3. **Abhidhamma Piṭaka** (Higher Doctrine): Dhammasaṅgaṇī, Vibhaṅga, Dhātukathā, Puggalapaññatti, Kathāvatthu, Yamaka, Paṭṭhāna, plus Aṭṭhakathā and Ṭīkā.
  4. **Añña Texts**: Post-canonical grammars, Visuddhimagga, chronicles (Vaṃsa), and commentaries.

## Reading URLs, Translations & Multi-Script Syntax
- **Default Roman Book**: `https://tipitakapali.org/book/[book_code]` (e.g. `https://tipitakapali.org/book/s0101m.mul` for Dīgha Nikāya Sīlakkhandhavagga)
- **Book with Translation**: `https://tipitakapali.org/book/[book_code]?l=[lang_code]` (e.g. `https://tipitakapali.org/book/s0101m.mul?l=en` for English, `https://tipitakapali.org/book/s0101m.mul?l=vi` for Vietnamese, `https://tipitakapali.org/book/s0101m.mul?l=my` for Burmese)
- **Multi-Script Book**: `https://tipitakapali.org/book/[script_code].[book_code]` (e.g. `https://tipitakapali.org/book/hi.s0101m.mul` for Devanagari, `https://tipitakapali.org/book/si.s0101m.mul` for Sinhala, `https://tipitakapali.org/book/my.s0101m.mul` for Myanmar, `https://tipitakapali.org/book/thai.s0101m.mul` for Thai)
- **Default Roman Chapter**: `https://tipitakapali.org/book/[book_code]/[chapter_number]` (e.g. `https://tipitakapali.org/book/s0101m.mul/2` for Chapter 2)
- **Chapter with Translation**: `https://tipitakapali.org/book/[book_code]/[chapter_number]?l=[lang_code]` (e.g. `https://tipitakapali.org/book/s0101m.mul/2?l=en`)
- **Specific Paragraph**: `https://tipitakapali.org/book/[book_code]#para-[number]` (e.g. `https://tipitakapali.org/book/s0502m.mul#para-1` for Dhammapada Verse 1)

### Supported 15 Modern Translation Languages (14M+ Aligned Sentences):
- `en`: **English** (English) 🇬🇧 → `https://tipitakapali.org/book/s0101m.mul?l=en` (English translation • 1.28M sentences)
- `vi`: **Vietnamese** (Tiếng Việt) 🇻🇳 → `https://tipitakapali.org/book/s0101m.mul?l=vi` (Bản dịch Tiếng Việt • 1.28M câu)
- `my`: **Myanmar / Burmese** (မြန်မာ) 🇲🇲 → `https://tipitakapali.org/book/s0101m.mul?l=my` (မြန်မာဘာသာပြန် • 1.28M စာကြောင်း)
- `my_nissaya`: **Myanmar Nissaya** (မြန်မာ နိဿယ) 🇲🇲 → `https://tipitakapali.org/book/s0101m.mul?l=my_nissaya` (Myanmar Nissaya word-by-word • 570K စာကြောင်း)
- `si`: **Sinhala** (සිංහල) 🇱🇰 → `https://tipitakapali.org/book/s0101m.mul?l=si` (සිංහල පරිවර්තනය • 1.21M වාක්‍ය)

- `km`: **Khmer** (ភាសាខ្មែរ) 🇰🇭 → `https://tipitakapali.org/book/s0101m.mul?l=km` (ការបកប្រែជាភាសាខ្មែរ • 1.18M ប្រយោគ)
- `lo`: **Lao** (ລາວ) 🇱🇦 → `https://tipitakapali.org/book/s0101m.mul?l=lo` (ການແປພາສາລາວ • 750K ປະໂຫຍກ)
- `ta`: **Tamil** (தமிழ்) 🇮🇳 → `https://tipitakapali.org/book/s0101m.mul?l=ta` (தமிழ் மொழிபெயர்ப்பு • 1.22M வாக்கியங்கள்)

- `id`: **Indonesian** (Bahasa Indonesia) 🇮🇩 → `https://tipitakapali.org/book/s0101m.mul?l=id` (Terjemahan Bahasa Indonesia • 1.22M kalimat)
- `ne`: **Nepali** (नेपाली) 🇳🇵 → `https://tipitakapali.org/book/s0101m.mul?l=ne` (नेपाली अनुवाद • 1.22M वाक्य)
- `be`: **Bengali** (বাংলা) 🇧🇩 → `https://tipitakapali.org/book/s0101m.mul?l=be` (বাংলা অনুবাদ • 93K বাক্য)

## Public Static JSON API (Edge CDN 0ms)
- Navigation Tree: `GET https://tipitakapali.org/api/tree`
- Books List: `GET https://tipitakapali.org/api/books`
- Book Details & Initial Chapters: `GET https://tipitakapali.org/api/book/[book_code]`
- Chapter HTML: `GET https://tipitakapali.org/api/book/[book_code]/chapter/[chapter_index]`
- Book Table of Contents: `GET https://tipitakapali.org/api/book/[book_code]/toc`
- Mūla-Aṭṭhakathā-Ṭīkā Cross Matrix: `GET https://tipitakapali.org/api/mat`
- Pāḷi Sentences (epitaka segmentation, shared line_id): `GET https://tipitakapali.org/api/book/[book_code]/pali_sentences` → `{chapters: {chapter: {para_index: [{line,text}]}}}`
- Translation Sentences: `GET https://tipitakapali.org/api/book/[book_code]/translation/[lang].sentences.json` (static) or `GET https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/book/[book_code]/chapter/[chapter_index]/translation?lang=[lang]&sentences=1` (VPS)

## AI Tool-Use: Canonical Dictionary, Search & Sentences (Direct VPS — no Worker hop)
> Canonical base for AI agents: `https://api.tipitakapali.org` (CORS `*`, `Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400`)
> Sentence-level note: Pāḷi sentences (`pali_sentences.db`, 1.2M sentences, 217 books) and translation sentences share `line_id` per paragraph by construction — **99.7% per-para line-count match**. Use `get_sentences` tool for precise sentence citations: `[book:c{chapter}:p{para}-L{line}]`.

- **DPD Primary Lookup (recommended first):** `GET https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/dict/lookup?w=mett%C4%81&dict=dpd`
  - Example live: `curl "https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/dict/lookup?w=mett%C4%81&dict=dpd"` → `{word, counts:{dpd:2}, dpd:[{word,html}]}`
- **Secondary Dictionaries (PTS, ABD, PSD, Sanskrit, Splitter):** `GET https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/dict/lookup?w=mett%C4%81&dict=others`
  - Returns `{counts:{pts,abd,psd,sans,splitter}, pts:[], abd:[], psd:[], sans:[], splitter:[]}`
- **All at once:** `GET https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/dict/lookup?w=mett%C4%81&dict=all` or `GET https://tipitakapali.org/api/dict/lookup?w=mett%C4%81&dict=all`
- **Inflection:** `GET https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/dict/inf?w=declension_mett%C4%81_1` → `{word, html}`
- **Full-Text Search:** `GET https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/search?q=anatta&pitaka=sutta&mat=mula&limit=50`
- Params: `w` (Pāḷi word, Velthuis or Unicode, `ṁ→ṃ` normalized), `dict` (`dpd`|`others`|`all`|`pts`|`abd`|`psd`|`sans`|`splitter`), `d=yes` for splitter.
- No auth, `CORS *`, `GET` preferred (POST also via `{w,dict}` JSON).

## Legacy Edge Proxies (also work, but direct VPS is faster)
- `GET https://tipitakapali.org/api/dict/lookup?w=[word]&dict=dpd` → proxied to VPS
- `GET https://tipitakapali.org/api/search?q=[query]` → proxied to VPS
